description: Configure trace monitoring of rblock properties for debugging and analysis.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: Use itasca.command('rblock trace ...') via command interface

keywords.name: id
keywords.description: Identify the rigid block to trace by its ID (a position vector may be given instead).

9.0: On the PFC 9.8 builds the trace is created but never sampled: trace export reports an empty list, trace list stays at the origin, and every trace gets ID 0, so address it by name. 9.00 and 7.0 record the path; on 9.8 sample the position with a history or a callback.
